name: tiffanyproduction.ba
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 21 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.
lesson: Validate each JSON-LD block after every release. One stray comma hides all of it.
summary: www.tiffanyproduction.ba scores 63 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: 21 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.

fix.title: 21 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /, /prijava?back_url=https://www.tiffanyproduction.ba/omiljeno, /zenska-kolekcija/aktuelno, /zenske-haljine/aktuelno and 16 more. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /prijava?back_url=https://www.tiffanyproduction.ba/omiljeno, /zenska-kolekcija/aktuelno, /zenske-haljine/aktuelno and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Images must have alternative text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 14 elements on /, for example img[fetchpriority="high"] and .slick-current.slick-active[data-slick-index="0"] > .nb-slider-item-box-7.nb-component > .nb-image-with-text-over.nb-com. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (3 requests), and cookies _ga, _ga_VEXTJZ5D0G.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 13 elements on /, /prijava?back_url=https://www.tiffanyproduction.ba/omiljeno, /zenska-kolekcija/aktuelno, for example .nb-header-wrapper > .nb-menu-icon-wrapper.nb-content-wrapper >…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: NBIDSN, order_limit. Without HttpOnly: NBPHPSESSIONSECURE. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /prijava?back_url=https://www.tiffanyproduction.ba/omiljeno, /zenska-kolekcija/aktuelno and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
